title: TikTok Seeks 4 GW of U.S. Computing Capacity by Early 2030s
summary: TikTok's U.S. division is currently searching for more data processing power to support its services, sources told CNBC. The company's domestic operations are seeking multiple gigawatts of compute capacity, with a target of 4 GW to be available by the early 2030s.
